scope: taxonomy-only; existing canonical Poaceae; no species-card/photo/lesson/installation/range/Pages/schedule writes
backbone: POWO/WCVP, checked 2026-10-25; corroboration from USDA/USACE, Flora of North America specialist interpretation reported by New York Flora Association, New York Botanical Garden, USDA NRCS and Native Plant Trust

scientific_decisions.reason: POWO/WCVP accepts this species in Poaceae; current canonical binomial is correct, author (Retz.) Koeler. No canonical edit.

scientific_decisions.reason: Both species are independently accepted under POWO and specialist treatments; merging the two would lose real taxonomic boundaries.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Proposed automatic merge of Setaria viridis into Setaria italica
scientific_decisions.reason: The crop and wild relative are separate accepted species under POWO; reciprocal infraspecific synonyms do not authorize a duplicate/merged learner concept.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Source photo and cultivar/hybrid identity of individual Setaria italica specimens
scientific_decisions.accepted_target: Species-level photographic identity and hybrid/cultivar provenance unverified
scientific_decisions.reason: Cultivation, escape, wild-relative resemblance, or a bristly head alone cannot prove a source specimen is a cultivar, introgressant, or hybrid. Do not infer parentage or reassign any image.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Incomplete historical 'foxtail millet' labels and crop–wild intermediate material
scientific_decisions.reason: For ambiguous specimens, inspect mature fertile lemma surface, disarticulation position and caryopsis rather than inferring S. italica versus S. viridis from vernacular labels or size alone.

follow_up: Maintain specimen/photo identity holds; source-labelled historical names require author/rank-aware mapping. Do not create duplicate accepted concepts or install related species without separate approval.
